prespecification.hypothesis: beta_b is larger in congested (peak) than free-flow (night) windows on weekdays
prespecification.primary_test: one-sided node-permutation test on beta_b(peak_union__weekday) - beta_b(night__weekday)

prespecification.multiplicity: Holm across the 12 pre-specified window tests; 24 hour-of-day bins are descriptive only
